question: Should OpenClaw core accept model-proposed follow-up task suggestions as gateway-owned `spawn_task` / `dismiss_task` tools with Control UI accept/dismiss and managed-worktree session creation?
rationale: This is a new core model-tool, Gateway protocol, Control UI, and worktree-session product surface, and the issue already has a protected maintainer label plus an open implementation candidate.

options.title: Review the linked implementation
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102422 as the canonical vehicle and decide there whether the product/security shape is acceptable.

options.title: Narrow to protocol/API design first
options.body: Keep this issue open but ask for a smaller design or prototype before accepting the full UI and worktree lifecycle.

options.title: Reject core scope
options.body: Close the issue and linked pull request if model-proposed task suggestions should remain prose, subagents, or an external/plugin-owned workflow.

recommendation.title: Review the linked implementation
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102422 as the canonical vehicle and decide there whether the product/security shape is acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the issue and open linked implementation, so they are the best available owner for the immediate product-direction decision.
